name: Translating the Journal
summary: A stranger in Kargath offers to translate the paladin’s journal. They know you seek their help and propose a deal involving Dran Droffers.

sections.title: A Translator in Kargath
sections.body: In the Badlands, you look for someone who can translate the paladin’s journal, and Kargath is the nearest place that might hold such a person. There, a stranger knows you seek a translation and the necklace parts from Uldaman. They claim to be the only one who can read the journal, then offer terms that would let you keep your agreement with Dran Droffers.

faq.q: Where can I find someone to translate the journal?
faq.answer: Kargath in the Badlands is the closest place that might have someone able to translate the paladin’s journal.

faq.q: Who says they can translate it?
faq.answer: A stranger in Kargath claims to be the only person you will find who can translate the paladin’s journal.

faq.q: What does the stranger know about me?
faq.answer: The stranger knows you are in the Badlands seeking their help and that you are after the necklace parts found in Uldaman.

faq.q: What does this have to do with Dran Droffers?
faq.answer: The stranger offers terms for translating the journal that they say would still let you complete your deal with Dran Droffers.
